youtube.description:
Max has been my enemy since kindergarten. He called me a scaredy-cat and said nothing ever happens in his boring house. So I moved into it. For a whole week. 👻
Seven days in his attic, stealing his dad's pancakes and haunting him every night. He had no idea... right? 🎃
